Hipermak · 2019 to 2021

Packaging machinery from the inside

Mechanical Design Engineer at a food processing and packaging machine builder, with direct design work on VFFS and HFFS machines. I designed a new auger filler for better product flow and dosing accuracy, and redesigned the sealing jaw mechanism of an intermittent VFFS machine. Food contact design in AISI 304 and 316L to FDA and 3A sanitary requirements, with FESTO pneumatics and Allen-Bradley systems, and technical coordination with suppliers in Germany and China.

Technical project management

Scope to delivery

Automotive taught me structure: phase gates, risk analysis and weekly reporting to headquarters. Running my own company taught me ownership: every project scope, timeline and client conversation was mine to deliver.

Requirements → Engineering → Suppliers → Delivered

02

03
Engineer

Drawings, design reviews and FMEA, with approved data controlled in PDM.

04

Deliverables, timelines and open issues reported weekly to stakeholders.

05

Deliver what was agreed and hand it over to the people who will use it.

Suppliers and maintenance

I speak the supplier's language

I have designed packaging mechanisms and worked inside a machine builder, and for four years I have negotiated projects with machine manufacturers. When a line has a problem, I can talk to the supplier engineer to engineer and work on it with the maintenance team right away.

Problems solved on site

Because I know how the mechanisms work, I can diagnose issues with the supplier remotely and solve them together with the plant's maintenance team, without waiting for the supplier's technicians and without stopping production.

Packaging machine builders as clients

Mapack and PowerPack, who build VFFS and HFFS machines as well as end of line systems, and end of line automation company Dedem Mekatronik were my clients. Visualizing their machines meant learning exactly how their solutions work.

A network of machine builders

I stay in close contact with packaging machine builders, including my former employer Hipermak, for quick technical second opinions and realistic reference offers.

Total cost of ownership

I know how machine quotes are built and what spare parts and wear parts cost, so offers can be compared on reliability and lifecycle cost, not only the purchase price.
